_comment: Last upstream versions whose on-disk transcript formats xtctx is known to handle. The nightly upstream-watch workflow compares npm against this file and opens an issue when a tracked tool publishes a new release — a free signal for when a format *could* have changed, without spending API credit invoking the tools. Update these after checking formats (npm run capture:formats).

_untracked.cursor: not distributed on npm — format changes ship with the Cursor app
_untracked.copilot (VS Code): not on npm — ships inside the VS Code extension
_untracked.antigravity: not on npm — ships with the Antigravity app
